name_zh: 肯尼亚·乔莫·肯雅塔：独立马乌马乌与土地部落族长
name_en: Kenya Jomo Kenyatta: Independence Mau Mau & Land Tribe Patriarch
description_zh: 乔莫·肯雅塔 (1897-1978) 肯尼亚首任总统 (1964-1978)，马乌马乌起义领袖，兰吉监狱七年磨砺，独立后推行非洲化与土地再分配，部落族长治国平衡基库尤与卡伦金族群。
description_en: Jomo Kenyatta (1897-1978) Kenya first President (1964-1978), Mau Mau uprising leader, Langi prison seven years tempering, post-independence Africanization and land redistribution, tribal patriarch governance balancing Kikuyu and Kalenjin groups.
reason_zh: 肯雅塔代表反殖武装斗争领袖如何转型为建国总统，展示了土地再分配如何成为后殖民国家合法性核心，其部落族长统治模式深刻塑造肯尼亚族群政治至今。
reason_en: Kenyatta represents how anti-colonial armed leader transforms into founding President, demonstrating how land redistribution becomes post-colonial state legitimacy core, his tribal patriarch governance model profoundly shapes Kenyan ethnic politics to this day.
steps_zh: 研究肯雅塔早年传教学校教育与伦敦经济学院留学
分析1952马乌马乌起义与兰吉监狱七年著作《面向肯尼亚山》
探讨1963年独立与非洲化土地再分配政策
评估基库尤精英垄断与卡伦金族群边缘化张力
总结独立马乌马乌土地部落族长对肯尼亚族群政治的决定性塑造
steps_en: Study Kenyatta early mission school education and LSE London studies
Analyze 1952 Mau Mau uprising and Langi prison seven years writing Facing Mount Kenya
Explore 1963 independence and Africanization land redistribution policy
Evaluate Kikuyu elite monopoly and Kalenjin marginalization tension
Summarize independence Mau Mau land tribal patriarch decisive shaping of Kenyan ethnic politics
expected_zh: 掌握武装斗争领袖向建国总统转型的合法性转化路径，理解土地再分配作为后殖民合法性核心的运作机制，评估肯雅塔族长模式对东非族群政治的长期遗产。
expected_en: Master armed leader to founding President legitimacy transformation path, understand land redistribution as post-colonial legitimacy core operating mechanism, evaluate Kenyatta patriarch model long-term legacy for East African ethnic politics.
case_zh: 1952 马乌马乌；1963 独立；1964 总理；1978 逝世。独立马乌马乌土地部落族长范式永存。
case_en: 1952 Mau Mau; 1963 independence; 1964 PM; 1978 death. Independence Mau Mau land tribal patriarch paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Independence leader; land redistribution; tribal politics; East African model
